title: An 86-minute guide to finding PMF | Rob Snyder (Author, The Power of Pull)
author: Lenny Rachitsky
description: Listen now (86 mins) | The founder who helped over 50 startups hit $1M ARR shares his PULL framework for finding real product-market fit
summary: Rob Snyder is the author of The Power of Pull and writes the newsletter The Physics of Startups . He has advised more than 50 startups on growing from zero to $1 million in ARR, drawing on his own experience as a founder who spent two years pushing a product the market didn’t want before accidentally stumbling onto what actually works.
takeaways: He has advised more than 50 startups on growing from zero to $1 million in ARR, drawing on his own experience as a founder who spent two years pushing a product the market didn’t want before accidentally stumbling onto what actually works.
In this episode, we walk step by step through his framework for finding product-market fit, from coming up with an idea to closing your first handful of deals.
